description: Look up whether a phone call may be recorded with one party's consent or needs every party's consent, for one or more US states, DC or Canadian provinces, by state or by the phone numbers on the call. Returns each jurisdiction's rule (one-party, all-party or mixed, such as Oregon, Connecticut, Nevada or Michigan, with the case law that decides it), the statute, a verbatim quote, the source URL and as-of date, the federal rule (18 U.S.C. 2511(2)(d)), and a bottom line for calls that cross state lines. With no input, returns the lists of all-party, mixed and one-party states. Informational, not legal advice.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers of the people on the call; each maps to its area code's state.

states.description: States or provinces of the people on the call, as codes or names.
